purpose: Measure literal scaffold adherence, ancestral-lineage elaboration, and prior-forward organism invention from four structurally divergent latent silhouette extrusions.
seedRule: 715000 + shape numeric id * 10 + stance index (1 preserve, 2 lineage, 3 prior-forward)

acceptance.routeIdentity: The hash-bound compact route receipt manifest preserves each Greenroom receipt, effective runner, effective parameters, exit state, input hash, and output hash.
acceptance.visual: One complete coherent organism; classify how much source gestalt survives, whether a distinctive structural event survives, and whether the departure discovers a selectable creature basin.
acceptance.failure: Reject icon or symbol collapse, duplicate organisms, severed-parts composition, blank or partial output, or unreceipted fallback output.
acceptance.downstream: Only visually inspected strong cells may become Trellis candidates.
